reviewType: Independent static source/test/installed-harness review; not full acceptance
reviewedContract: Date values are serialized by JSON.stringify only for Date fields, matching quoted ISO output without adding unrelated object/array handling.
Successful supported text metadata uses lineCount-1 including -1 for the empty-file sentinel; fields and order match inspected pin.
Directory fileType=text is explicitly documented as a handler discriminator, with no content read or line metadata.
Binary, invalid UTF-8 and over-limit fallback remains honest and omits fileType/line fields; office/image stat-only behavior remains unchanged.
Signal is forwarded by the real MCP handler; cancellation is checked at entry and after awaited policy/stat/read operations and catch/final response boundaries.
Fallback accepts only the three existing bounded content ToolErrors or an explicit ordinary errno allowlist; policy, changed-path, cancellation and unexpected errors propagate.
A symlink or hardlink replacement seen by the post-resolution lstat is rejected; a forbidden replacement during optional read is rejected through the existing FileService.
Installed verifier exercises seven metadata scenario groups then a separate read-only process for group eight; existing six directory groups remain intact.
Read-only child identity is captured before discovery/capability assertions; all thirteen current write/exec/config-write tool names are absent and capability booleans are false.
Both installed launchers and actual server PIDs are independently checked for exit; unknown identity or close failure prevents a passing result.
Metadata fixtures are under the owned listing root and removed only after confirmed first-process exits; package evidence scope remains retained for recovery.
Package report now preserves the child compatibility scenario/cleanup report rather than only its alias count.
